name: manual_76cbf6
claim: A 'walk this directory and copy or record everything' tool (e.g. a blend-promote script's find $DIR -type f) must explicitly exclude build and bytecode-cache artifacts like __pycache__ compiled files -- .gitignore protects git commits but not tool-level file-walk bookkeeping that reads the raw filesystem directly, so a stray verification command's side-effect files can get silently copied and catalogued as if they were real content.

decisions.notes: cmd_promote in agentic-stack-agent-blend.sh picked up 2 compiled-bytecode files created as a side effect of an earlier manual py_compile verification run against the preview dir, copying and cataloguing them as legitimate blended content; fixed via a -not -path exclusion for the cache directory.
